csv_scope_of_work: The University of Maryland, Baltimore County (UMBC), a constituent institution of the University System of Maryland and an agency of the State of Maryland (herein referred to as the "University" or "UMBC"), is seeking proposals from a consultant propose a high-level work plan and lead the development of the University s new 10- year Facilities Master Plan (FMP). 1. Toward continually enhancing campus stewardship and alignment to UMBC s Strategic Plan, the Offeror shall demonstrate the ability to: Analyze and make insightful use of available data, Describe and assess the relevant baselines, Organize large, varied, and complex data sets into coherent models, Observe and clearly document existing needs and conditions, Knowledgeably propose and apply suitable higher ed benchmarks, Understand academic program needs in a facilities context, Understand the role of different partnering structures and alternative funding models for augmenting state capital support or USM debt, Find avenues through the planning process and outcomes to deepen the Institution s connections to the neighboring communities and region, Make clear and engaging presentations of findings and recommendations, Tailor presentations to diverse internal and external stakeholder groups, Facilitate and moderate discussions addressing varied viewpoints, Differentiate and integrate findings into expert decision support, Create compelling plans, diagrams, and renderings, Unify and distill diverse reports and visuals into a single balanced and persuasive plan.
csv_disciplines_requested: Interior Design/Space Planning, Landscape Architecture, Programming, Civil Engineering, Land Use Planning, Planning/Master Planning
